home.hero_sub: Student leader, STEM enthusiast, and community organizer. From leading fundraising committees to competing at world-level competitions, I turn ideas into impact.

about.intro: I'm a high school student who thrives at the intersection of leadership, innovation, and service. Whether it's organizing a recreational soccer league, competing at Odyssey of the Mind Worlds, or raising $1,000 for charity, I believe in taking initiative and making things happen.
highlights: Vice President, Curtner Student Council Fundraising Committee
Odyssey of the Mind World Finalist (2023 & 2024)
Boy Scouts of America - Troop 92, Milpitas
about.bio: Growing up in Milpitas, I've always been drawn to leadership roles and hands-on problem solving. From founding my school's Origami Club to organizing recreational sports leagues and competing in international STEM competitions, I've learned that the best way to create change is to take action. Every experience has taught me something new about teamwork, resilience, and the power of community.

activities.title: Student Council
activities.description: As a member and Vice President of the Fundraising Committee at Curtner, I helped plan events, manage budgets, and rally student participation to fund school-wide initiatives.
achievements: Planned and executed multiple school fundraising events
President, Curtner Origami Club - grew membership to 10-15 active members
Student SMB owner at Entrepreneur Fair (2023-24)

activities.title: STEM & Innovation
activities.description: Competing in VEX Robotics and Odyssey of the Mind has pushed me to think creatively under pressure, collaborate with diverse teams, and solve complex problems at the highest level.
achievements: Odyssey of the Mind World Finalist - Michigan (2023) & Iowa (2024)
Head of Marketing, Summer Bizworld Entrepreneurs Club (2022)

activities.title: Boy Scouts
activities.description: As a member of BSA Troop 92 in Milpitas, I'm developing leadership, outdoor survival skills, and a commitment to service that extends beyond the classroom.
achievements: Developing outdoor and leadership skills through merit badge work

activities.title: Sports
activities.description: As a defense player in competitive soccer and organizer of a recreational league, I've experienced sports from both sides - competing at a high level and building community through play.
achievements: Defense Player, Competitive Soccer League, Milpitas (2022-24)
Organizer, Recreational Soccer League at Curtner (2024)
Balanced competitive athletics with leadership in community sports

activities.title: Community Service
activities.description: Giving back is core to who I am. From organizing fundraisers to supporting family-driven charitable causes, I'm committed to making a positive impact in my community.
achievements: Fundraiser, Family Giving Tree Wish Drive (2020) - raised $1,000
Supported community giving through hands-on event organization
